title: Settings
description: Account, DeepSeek AI, GitHub PAT, and preferences

toasts.trackingSaved: Tracking thresholds updated and health recalculated
toasts.publicBrowsingSaveFailed: Failed to save public browsing setting

password.title: Change password
password.newMin: New password must be at least 8 characters

deepseek.description: Used for one-line summaries, folder suggestions, and smart tags. Keys are stored with AES-GCM encryption.
deepseek.savedKeyPlaceholder: Saved key (****{{last4}}), leave blank to keep

anysearch.description: Optional. Enables the "Web" toggle in library chat so answers can be supplemented with web results. Keys are stored with AES-GCM encryption and used server-side only.
anysearch.savedKeyPlaceholder: Saved key (****{{last4}}), leave blank to keep
anysearch.keyRequired: Please enter an AnySearch API Key
anysearch.hint: Create a key in the console:
anysearch.clearConfirm: Clear the AnySearch API Key? Library chat will lose web search.

github.description: Optional. A PAT raises GitHub REST API rate limits for stars and sync.
github.savedPatPlaceholder: Saved PAT (****{{last4}}), leave blank to keep

tracking.description: The system syncs GitHub activity every 6 hours. Adjust hot / stale day thresholds; saving recalculates locally from existing push times without extra GitHub calls. Per-bookmark tracking can be disabled in detail view.

bookmarkList.description: Instance-level setting: how the bookmarks page loads more items. Signed-in users and public visitors share the same configuration.
bookmarkList.modeHint: Both append modes enable virtual scrolling, so long lists only render cards near the viewport.
bookmarkList.pageSizeInvalid: Items per page must be an integer between 1 and 100

visibility.description: Control whether signed-out visitors can read-only browse bookmarks and feed.
visibility.publicBrowsingDescription: When enabled, anyone with the link can read bookmarks and feed; when disabled, sign-in is required. Adding bookmarks and creating folders still require sign-in. Private notes stay hidden from guests.

export.description: Export all bookmarks, folders, and tags as JSON. Site accounts and passwords are excluded.
export.title: Export full library JSON
export.detail: Includes private notes, AI summaries, tags, and timestamps — not site accounts or passwords
